notes: config.json fetched 2026-10-18. model_type alice_ai with custom modeling via auto_map (configuration_alice_ai.AliceAIConfig / modeling_alice_ai.AliceAIForCausalLM), so it does not load in stock transformers without the repo code and trust_remote_code.
